overview.banner: Research / shadow mode. Picks are recorded in shadow only: nothing is published and nothing is bet. What they would have done is measured in Performance.

live.title: In play now
live.subtitle: Tracked matches being played: score and minute from the live follow, refreshed every 15 seconds
live.empty: No tracked match is in play.

upcoming.title: Upcoming matches
upcoming.subtitle: Scheduled fixtures of the competitions the capturer tracks
upcoming.empty: No scheduled fixture is stored for today or later. The worker syncs the tracked competitions' fixtures every 12 hours.

headers.pricesHelp: Pre-match price snapshots captured so far

worker.subtitle: Liveness from its heartbeat, written on every tick
worker.neverBeat: No heartbeat has ever been written: the worker has not run with this version.
worker.noTick: No tick has run since the worker started.

provider.title: Provider & quota
provider.subtitle: Our budget, counted in the database before each request
provider.noError: No run has recorded a provider error.

picks.subtitle: Shadow picks only; publishing is disabled

performance.title: Performance
performance.subtitle: Reported only from settled picks with recorded prices
performance.pnlHint: No settled pick with a recorded price
performance.roiHint: Not computable without a settled sample

picks.banner: Publishing is disabled by a database constraint. Every pick here is shadow research output, not advice, and no model has yet qualified: qualification needs the exact model version to have beaten the de-vigged market in its own backtest.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.hint: failed the rule, with the reason

qualified.label: Qualified
qualified.hint: model beat the market in its backtest

rule.title: Decision rule
rule.subtitle: Fixed and versioned before it sees a result

shadow.title: Shadow picks
shadow.subtitle: Click a pick for its lineage

candidates.title: Recent candidates
candidates.subtitle: The last 50 prices evaluated, selected or not

lineage.noInterval: No interval was computed for this forecast.

settlement.title: Settlement: how long each match waited
settlement.subtitle: From the moment we saw it end until its picks were settled (first settlement per match, last 7 days). The provider publishes no exact end time: it lies between the last state seen in play and the first seen ended.
settlement.noReason: Should settle within the next minute

analyst.notConfigured: No language model is configured on the API host ({missing} unset), so the analyst cannot answer. Nothing is sent anywhere. The tools below are exactly what it would read, and they work now.

ask.title: Ask
ask.subtitle: Questions go to the API host, which calls the model and the tools. The browser never sees a key.
ask.placeholder: e.g. How did Dixon-Coles do against the market?
ask.placeholderOff: Not configured on the API host
ask.label: Question for the analyst
ask.unverified: Unverified figures (not found in any tool result): {figures}
